name: @pipeworx/mcp-hash

tools.name: hash
tools.description: Compute a cryptographic hash (hex digest) of text: algorithm = md5, sha1, sha256 (default), sha384, or sha512. Keyless/offline; the input is not stored or transmitted. MD5/SHA-1 are legacy (checksums only, not security).

tools.name: hmac
tools.description: Compute an HMAC (hex) of text with a secret key. algorithm = sha1, sha256 (default), sha384, or sha512. Keyless/offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-hash forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the hash pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
